name: wpf-xaml
description: WPF and Visual Studio Remote UI XAML rules for MVVM, binding, threading, virtualization, resources, theme colors, and accessibility, with explicit Remote UI exceptions.

interface.shortDescription: WPF and Remote UI XAML rules
interface.longDescription: A skills-only plugin with checkable WPF rules for MVVM, CommunityToolkit.Mvvm, Dispatcher threading, UI virtualization, freezables, resources, theme colors, and accessibility. Each rule states how it changes for Visual Studio Remote UI XAML.
defaultPrompt: Review this WPF view for binding and threading problems.
